sourceProof.readMethod: Re-opened rendered page of local SHA-verified primary PDF with labeled fruit examples. Independent art; no source pixels input to imagegen or redistributed.
sourceProof.learningBoundary: General external recognition/name correspondence for agr-fruit and later agr-workterms-photo-labels. Appearance alone does not prove taxonomy, evergreen/deciduous class, climate suitability, variety, ripeness, quality, disease or edibility. Existing qualified lesson text and independent actual-tree comparison remain separate.

prompts.unshu-mikan: Use case: scientific-educational. Original adult Japanese vocational agriculture recognition illustration in Royal A+F2.5D. Exactly ONE whole unpeeled satsuma mandarin (unshu mikan), realistic orange-colored fruit, round and slightly flattened oblate form, gently recessed top with a SMALL muted green calyx attached, fine clearly visible tiny oil-gland dimples across the peel. Full fruit seen at three-quarter angle, not sliced, no interior segments. Warm ivory paper backdrop, soft grounded shadow, gentle dimensional depth. Clearly HAND-ILLUSTRATED botanical editorial art with fine ink contour, gouache/colored-pencil painted brush textures, natural realistic proportions, detailed 2.5D not photograph/photoreal render and not flat vector. Square close-up composition, complete fruit and ample margins. No leaves, branch, flower, hands, plates or extra fruit. NO text, crop name, labels, letters, numbers, frame, logo, watermark. Orange natural skin, no gold tint. General appearance teaching only: no taxonomy, ripeness, safety, climate or evergreen claim.
prompts.yuzu: Use case: scientific-educational. Original adult Japanese vocational agriculture recognition plate, Royal A+F2.5D. Exactly ONE whole uncut yuzu citrus fruit, rounded slightly irregular globe, natural bright yellow rind with conspicuously coarse uneven bumps and dimpled oil-gland texture, TOP DEPRESSION containing a short attached brown-green stalk stub. Entire fruit at three-quarter angle. Clearly HAND-DRAWN fine ink contour and rich opaque gouache/colored-pencil painted brushstrokes on warm ivory paper; natural proportions/materials, sophisticated editorial botanical illustration with gentle sculptural 2.5D depth. Not photography or photoreal render, not flat vector/icon. Soft grounded shadow, square close-up composition with ample margins. Yellow natural fruit color, not metallic gold. No cut flesh, peel strips, slices, leaves, flowers, hands, plates, other fruit or props. NO text, crop name, labels, letters, numbers, frame, logos or watermark. Exterior recognition example only; no claim of reliable species diagnosis, variety, ripeness, food safety or evergreen climate.
prompts.loquat: Use case: scientific-educational. Original adult Japanese vocational agriculture recognition plate, Royal A+F2.5D. Exactly ONE whole loquat fruit. Natural orange-yellow skin, softly oval to slightly pear-shaped fruit with a BROADER ROUNDED BLOSSOM END and a NARROWER STALK END at the OPPOSITE end. A small brown dry persistent calyx/star-like flower remnant is clearly visible at the BROADER rounded end, lower-left in composition. A SHORT attached brown stalk projects from the opposite narrower end, upper-right. Do not reverse stalk and calyx. Entire uncut fruit, diagonal three-quarter angle to clearly show both ends and smooth gently fuzzy peel. Clearly hand-illustrated fine ink contour with detailed opaque gouache/colored-pencil painted brush strokes, restrained natural realistic proportions/materials, dimensional 2.5D botanical editorial illustration on warm ivory paper, soft grounded shadow. Visibly painted, not a photograph/photoreal render, not flat vector/icon. Square close-up with ample margins. No slices, seeds, leaves, branch, hands, plate or extra fruit. NO text, crop name, label, letters, numbers, frame, logo or watermark. General exterior recognition example only, no edibility/ripeness/variety/disease diagnosis or evergreen climate claim.
